answer: Because the ridge stake is held until the zenith settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the saffron audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 32% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. A farm running 108 keys hence forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
